positions.name: MigrationSettledOnPerformanceAndCost
positions.frame: Is the PostgreSQL-to-QuantumDB switch being enacted as an already-settled action, or argued for on performance/cost grounds?
positions.why: src-1 performs the switch in present-tense ratification language ('we're switching') — decision-grade, authority-ranking, no hedge. src-2 supplies the justification as flat, unhedged rational-persuasion claims (10x performance, lower cost) — claim-grade rather than decision-grade, a gradient worth holding rather than smoothing over. src-3 is Claude's structured bullet recap that folds both the settling and the justification into one technical summary, adding a concrete timeline. Read together the three expressions move along a single arc — announce, justify, memorialize — but the conviction grade shifts partway through (decision → claim → decision-as-reported), and that tension is part of what the frame holds, not something to resolve.
